title: Jonathon Cooper is expected to report to Denver Broncos training camp

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Jonathon Cooper is expected to report to Denver Broncos training camp
sources.description: According to The Denver Post’s Parker Gabriel, Denver Broncos edge rusher Jonathon Cooper is expected to report to training camp today with the rest of the team’s veteran players. As we know, he has been dealing with some off-the-field legal drama, and the team has expressed its disappointment with what happened, but it appears Cooper […]
